note: Finn's sighting of Roz is now leverage that needs Roz's beacon poster, which gives Finn no reason to speak of what he saw in the cottage: a lock with no fitting reason that the structural checks accept.

patch.value: Finn doesn't think Roz's visit matters until he hears the tide schedule was changed. A clever question about who was alone in the cottage yesterday can also jog his memory.
Finn will only say who he saw in the cottage once you have read Roz's beacon poster on the lamp shop door.
